#Part I

required_packages <- c("DBI", "duckdb", "nycflights13")

for (pkg in required_packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
  }
}

library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(nycflights13)
db_file <- "flights.duckdb"
if (!file.exists(db_file)) {
  download.file("https://data-science-master.github.io/lectures/data/flights.duckdb", 
                destfile = db_file, 
                mode = "wb")
}


conn <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = db_file)
## duckdb is storing downloaded extensions and secrets under ~/.duckdb:
## ℹ C:\Users\auuser/.duckdb
## This persists across sessions and is shared with the DuckDB CLI and other clients.
## ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = FALSE) to use a temporary directory instead.
## ℹ See ?duckdb_storage for details and alternatives.

#B) Number of flights

#i) Total Flights in the Dataset

total_flights <- dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_flights FROM flights;")
print(total_flights)
##   total_flights
## 1        336776

#ii) Number of Flights Per Carrier

flights_per_carrier <- dbGetQuery(conn, "
  SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS num_flights 
  FROM flights 
  GROUP BY carrier 
  ORDER BY num_flights DESC;
")
print(flights_per_carrier)
##    carrier num_flights
## 1       UA       58665
## 2       B6       54635
## 3       EV       54173
## 4       DL       48110
## 5       AA       32729
## 6       MQ       26397
## 7       US       20536
## 8       9E       18460
## 9       WN       12275
## 10      VX        5162
## 11      FL        3260
## 12      AS         714
## 13      F9         685
## 14      YV         601
## 15      HA         342
## 16      OO          32

#C) Find the Average Departure Delay

avg_dep_delay <- dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT AVG(dep_delay) AS avg_dep_delay FROM flights;")
print(avg_dep_delay)
##   avg_dep_delay
## 1      12.63907

The average delay for flights was 12.6 minutes.

#D) Find the most travelled by destinations

top_destinations <- dbGetQuery(conn, "
  SELECT f.dest AS destination, a.name AS airport_name, COUNT(*) AS num_flights 
  FROM flights f
  LEFT JOIN airports a ON f.dest = a.faa
  GROUP BY f.dest, a.name 
  ORDER BY num_flights DESC 
  LIMIT 5;
")

print(top_destinations)
##   destination                       airport_name num_flights
## 1         ORD                 Chicago Ohare Intl       17283
## 2         ATL    Hartsfield Jackson Atlanta Intl       17215
## 3         LAX                   Los Angeles Intl       16174
## 4         BOS General Edward Lawrence Logan Intl       15508
## 5         MCO                       Orlando Intl       14082

The five most popular destinations are Chicago, Atlanta, Los Angeles, Boston, and Orlando.

#E) Create a delay table in descending order

avg_arr_delay_carrier <- dbGetQuery(conn, "
  SELECT carrier, AVG(arr_delay) AS avg_arr_delay 
  FROM flights 
  GROUP BY carrier 
  ORDER BY avg_arr_delay DESC;
")

print(avg_arr_delay_carrier)
